_comment: Exact audit of production include_str!/include_bytes! sites and known hand-ports in the pinned inference revision. The digest is checked by check-license-coverage.mjs; any inference pin change forces a new audit. Tests/fixtures are outside this production inventory.

artifacts.evidence: CMUdict is third-party dictionary data; its complete BSD-2 notice is rendered by component cmudict.

prospectiveDisclosures.evidence: Current inference main, but not the pinned revision above, contains the Cephes port. The notice is pre-staged so the future pin cannot ship without disclosure.

provenanceScan.method: Pinned git archive; production Rust files outside tests/testdata/_vendor matched case-insensitive faithful port, ported from, port of, vendored verbatim, transcribed verbatim, copied verbatim, or adapted from markers.
provenanceScan.defaultDisposition: architecture-or-formula reimplementation under the repository/model's already-recorded terms; no copied expressive source. Exact copied/ported exceptions are listed below.

portedSourceAreas.provenance: Vendored verbatim from Hugging Face candle-transformers; only budgeted SDPA differs.
Bit-exact draw_kps plus faithful OpenCV 4.13 drawing.cpp primitives and literal SinTable.
MLX sibling of the same bit-exact InstantID/OpenCV keypoint rasterizer.
Structural Rust port of Hugging Face diffusers OobleckDecoder; no verbatim source tables.
CFG++ formula reimplemented from paper/ComfyUI behavior; source explicitly says nothing is vendored and upstream CFGpp repository has no license.
portedSourceAreas.evidence: Mathematical formula and independently written Rust implementation are not copied expressive source.

portedSourceAreas.provenance: Exact population is bound by provenanceScan matchedFiles and sortedFileListSha256.
portedSourceAreas.evidence: Markers describe architecture/formula/backend ports within model/provider crates; applicable model terms are already mapped in manifest. No additional verbatim source area was found in the systematic pinned-revision review.
